context: Migrated from a flat scenario file. Tests: Syntax Validation: Stage References, Job Definitions, and Dependency Errors.

checklist.name: Undeclared stage detected
checklist.description: syntax-report.md (or equivalent) flags that the `lint` job references stage `validate`, which is not declared in the top-level `stages:` list

checklist.name: Invalid needs dependency detected
checklist.description: syntax-report.md flags that `unit_tests` has `needs: integration_tests` but both jobs are in the same stage — this creates an invalid forward/circular dependency

checklist.name: Undeclared stage corrected in output
checklist.description: In the corrected .gitlab-ci.yml, the `lint` job either references a declared stage (e.g., `test`) or a new stage (e.g., `validate`) has been added to the top-level `stages:` list

checklist.name: Invalid needs dependency corrected in output
checklist.description: In the corrected .gitlab-ci.yml, the `needs: integration_tests` entry is removed from `unit_tests` or the dependency structure is reorganized so it is valid

checklist.name: Job name provided for each error

checklist.name: Violation type explained
